Smart power grid: daily challenge, 2026-12-24

The shared System Designer challenge for 2026-12-24: Smart power grid. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free with a Google or GitHub account.

Open the challenge

A power company has 5 million smart meters. Each reports usage every 15 minutes, and they all try on the quarter hour. Customers see their usage, billing needs exact totals for seven years, and a regulator checks that records are kept safely. Control commands to home batteries and thermostats must never run twice.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.

Related problems

  • Medium

    Insurance claims

    After a hailstorm, thousands of drivers file claims online, each with a handful of photos. The storm offer ends at 5 pm, so everyone files at the last minute. Every claim must be saved safely, and every customer gets a confirmation email.

  • Easy

    Benefits application portal

    People apply for food, health or housing help on a state site. Forms are long, people save drafts and upload documents, and a caseworker team reviews each one. The last week of the month is busy, and an auditor checks the privacy and access controls once a year.

  • Hard

    Tax filing deadline

    A national tax site lets 30 million people file online. Most wait until deadline day, and traffic climbs all evening to a final-hour rush. People upload forms, check what they owe and pay. A mistake in a payment or a leak of tax data is a national story.

  • Medium

    Fleet telemetry

    A freight company has 150,000 trucks that each send a batch of sensor readings every 30 seconds. Dispatchers watch live maps and analysts run reports. You must take in every batch, keep a month of detail cheaply, and survive the moments when thousands of trucks come back online at once.
